dogecoin.text: Solo mining a full block shows that even small players can still compete in PoW networks. Congrats on the 3.154 $BTC reward! For perspective, similar luck in $LTC or $DOGE is rarer.
Crypto’s emotional cycles mirror traditional markets; don’t FOMO into peaks or despair at troughs. Keep a long‑term mindset whether you’re holding $SOL, $AVAX or even $DOGE.
